scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT/STEM simulations infeasible in verifier sandbox; compare reported ratios and defect levels against paper-derived gold values with tolerances and trend check.

outputs.description: ADF-STEM intensity ratios (defect‑site intensity divided by Mo‑site intensity) for the P_Se and V_Se defects.
Acceptor defect level energies (above VBM) for N, P, and As substitutional dopants in MoSe₂.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for QSTEM intensity ratios and DFT defect levels, extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text and supporting info: P_Se ratio 86% (Figure 2d), V_Se 66% (Figure 2e); N level 0.66 eV (Ref 6, cited in text); P level ≈0.3 eV (experimental STS and DFT); As level shallower trend from supporting info (value 0.10 eV as extracted from paper's DFT SI).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numbers reported in the paper, ensuring that only an agent who correctly computes or accurately reconstructs the quantities matches them.
